note: SYD has no Deldatamängder sheet, so the build synthesizes its one variant `_default` and delivers every SYD column there (route-sos-places-token-variables-in-the-default-or-every-routed-subset). A variant-scoped representation edge in such a register can only name `_default`: COL is replaced by NEU in 2010 within `_default`. Variant references already keep the reserved slug (relations-replaced-by-edges-are-written-at-their-own-grain); before this case the representation edge's scope refused it, and the build aborted with an unlocated pipeline_build_failed. The expected row is the edge as authored: every curated edge's note is `curated:slug_toml` and the edge's own note is its description.
fails_if: `ResolvedRepresentationSuccession` (resolved_metadata.py) validates its variant scope as a plain slug instead of a register_variant slug, so it refuses `_default` and the build fails instead of writing the edge

sources.description: SOS register SYD, with no Deldatamängder sheet, delivers COL and NEU in TOKEN over 2005-2015.
